info.name: TSPark API Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for TSPark fitness challenge platform.

## Testing Flow (Follow This Order!)

This collection is organized in sequential order. Run folders 0-7 in order for a complete test flow:

1. **0. Health Check** - Verify API is running
2. **1. Setup - Login All Users** - Get JWT tokens for seeded users
3. **2. Super Admin: Exercises** - Create exercises (required for challenges)
4. **3. Gym Owner: Gyms** - Create gym (starts as PENDING)
5. **4. Super Admin: Approve Gym** - Approve gym (PENDING → APPROVED)
6. **5. Gym Owner: Challenges** - Create & start challenges
7. **6. Client: Join & Participate** - Join challenges, log workouts
8. **7. Social & Badges** - Friend requests, badges
9. **99. Destructive Operations** - DELETE endpoints (run manually)

## User Roles
- **Super Admin**: Full platform access, create exercises, approve gyms, manage badges
- **Gym Owner**: Create/manage gyms, create challenges
- **Client**: Join gyms/challenges, log workouts, social features

## Seeder Credentials
Run `npm run seed` first to create these users:
- admin@tspark.com / SuperAdmin123!
- gymowner@tspark.com / GymOwner123!
- client1@tspark.com / Client123!
- client2@tspark.com / Client123!

## API Documentation
Swagger UI: http://localhost:3000/api/docs

item.name: 2. Super Admin: Create Exercises
item.description:
**Role Required**: Super Admin

Exercises must be created BEFORE challenges (for recommended exercises).

Only Super Admins can create exercises.

item.name: 5. Gym Owner: Create & Start Challenge
item.description:
**Role Required**: Gym Owner or Super Admin

**Prerequisites**:
- ✅ Exercises created (step 2)
- ✅ Gym created AND APPROVED (steps 3-4)

**Challenge Lifecycle**:
1. Create challenge → status: DRAFT
2. Start challenge → status: ACTIVE
3. Users can join ACTIVE challenges
4. Complete/Cancel when done

request.description:
Create a challenge.

**Status**: DRAFT (cannot accept participants yet)

**Auto-saves**: `{{challengeId}}`

**Note**: Dates are automatically set via pre-request script (today → +30 days)!

body.raw:
{
  "title": "30-Day Strength Challenge",
  "description": "Build muscle and strength over 30 days with our structured workout program.",
  "type": "individual",
  "difficulty": "medium",
  "objectives": {
    "targetWorkouts": 20,
    "targetCalories": 5000,
    "targetDuration": 600
  },
  "startDate": "{{challengeStartDate}}",
  "endDate": "{{challengeEndDate}}",
  "pointsReward": 500,
  "isPublic": true,
  "maxParticipants": 100,
  "gymId": "{{gymId}}",
  "recommendedExerciseIds": ["{{exerciseId}}"]
}

item.name: 6. Client: Join Challenge & Log Workouts
item.description:
**Role Required**: Client (any authenticated user)

**Prerequisites**:
- ✅ Challenge is ACTIVE (step 5.3)
- ✅ Current date is within challenge date range

Clients can join active challenges and log workouts.

request.description: View public challenges available to join.

Join an ACTIVE challenge.

**Requirements**:
- Challenge must be ACTIVE
- Must be within date range
- Cannot already be a participant

Log a workout session.

Contributes to challenge progress!

**Auto-saves**: `{{workoutId}}`

No strict dependencies - can be tested independently.

item.name: 99. Destructive Operations (DELETE)
item.description:
⚠️ **DESTRUCTIVE OPERATIONS**

These endpoints DELETE data permanently.

Run manually - NOT part of automated flow.

request.description: Soft-delete a challenge. The challenge is marked as deleted but preserved for history.
List all soft-deleted challenges. Super Admin only.
Restore a soft-deleted challenge. Creator or Super Admin only.
Soft-delete a badge. The badge is preserved for user badge history.
List all soft-deleted badges. Super Admin only.
Restore a soft-deleted badge. Super Admin only.
